nodes.label: Import wizard silently drops 2 of 4 CSV columns
nodes.rationale: The dropped names are valid options inside the surviving dropdowns, so the field list is correct and the defect is in the header-detection loop, not a translation gap.

nodes.label: Import rejects an existing division as DIVISION_NOT_FOUND
nodes.rationale: The error is keyed 'divisionSlug', suggesting slug matching, while the page instructions say to supply the Division name shown everywhere else in the product.

nodes.label: Import row-validation errors and raw error-code badge unlocalized
nodes.rationale: A constant-style DIVISION_NOT_FOUND badge reads as an internal error code leaking into end-user UI, separate from the missing translation.

nodes.label: Schedule board breadcrumb and weekday tabs stay English
nodes.rationale: The H1 is correctly French while the breadcrumb segment and day-tab date formatting bypass the locale-aware formatter.

nodes.label: Schedule board select-then-place interaction
nodes.rationale: Click-to-select then click-to-place rather than HTML5 drag-and-drop; verified working and arguably more mobile-friendly than a real drag interaction.

nodes.label: Free-tier account is English-locale and masks i18n regressions
nodes.rationale: Not a product bug but a test-coverage gap: with no locale mismatch the account cannot expose leaks, so a French-locale account must stay in the rotation.
